name: 0xarchive
description: Agent-ready 0xArchive market data skill for coding-agent clients across two venues: Hyperliquid and Lighter. Hyperliquid includes HIP-3 builder perps, HIP-4 outcome markets, and Hyperliquid Spot; Lighter has two deployments, mainnet and Robinhood Chain. Covers account positions by Hyperliquid wallet or Lighter account index. REST and WebSocket support are route-specific and listed by GET /v1/capabilities; Lighter orderbook, trades, open interest, and funding stream live on both deployments, while Lighter candles and L3 are replay-only; L4 channels stream live and replay on Hyperliquid core, HIP-3, HIP-4, and Spot. Covers stable error codes, has_more pagination, and the 0xArchive-Version header. Also ships 0xarchive-backtest: a quant research and backtesting workflow (route a wallet, idea, script, paper or backtest; trial ledger, sealed holdout, gauntlet verdict) on its own Rust engine, 0xbt.
